<?php
function shift202() { echo "SHIFT;"; return 7; }
function warning202($errno, $message, $file, $line) { global $later; $later = 42; echo "WARN;"; return true; }
class Base202 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return null; } }
set_error_handler("warning202"); $owner = new Base202; $owner->missing(shift202(), $later); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift202() { global $later; $later = []; echo "SHIFT;"; return 7; }
class Base202 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return null; } }
$owner = new Base202; $owner->missing(shift202(), $later); echo "AFTER;";

<?php
function shift202() { global $later; $later = 2; echo "SHIFT;"; return 7; }
class Holder202 { public int $value = 1; }
class Base202 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { echo "HANDLER;"; return null; } }
$holder = new Holder202; $later =& $holder->value; $owner = new Base202; $owner->missing(shift202(), $later); echo "AFTER;";
